name: Raw AAS / peptide powders (pre-formulation)
route_label: parenteral (most-protective; a pre-formulation raw material may be reconstituted for injection)
method: HMTc Method v2.1. Lead, cadmium, total arsenic, total mercury, nickel, tin, and total chromium are read across from the ICH Q3D(R2) Table A.2.2 Option 1 oral concentration limits. Aluminium is read across from the EU drinking-water limit at 200 ug/kg. Inorganic arsenic, methylmercury, and hexavalent chromium do not carry a separate numeric ceiling. Each is capped at its parent total and tested on every lot.
governing_basis: The published cells are disclosed read-across ceilings. Seven metals (Pb, Cd, tAs, tHg, Ni, Sn, Cr) take the ICH Q3D(R2) Table A.2.2 Option 1 oral concentrations. Aluminium takes the EU drinking-water limit of 200 ug/kg. Inorganic arsenic is capped at total arsenic, methylmercury at total mercury, and hexavalent chromium at total chromium, and each species is tested on every lot. Certification is metal safety only. It does not speak to efficacy, legality, or approval status.
scope_note: Bulk raw powders (active pharmaceutical ingredient grade or lower) sold pre-formulation for home reconstitution into injectable oils or oral preparations. Because the same powder may be reconstituted for injection, the most-protective route is applied and the escalation anchor is the parenteral ICH Q3D PDE, consistent with the Step Zero lock's treatment of the parenteral pathway as the most severe. Craven 2025 analysed 2 raw powders (lead 1.18 ug/g; aluminium 51.73 ug/g).
certification_scope: Heavy-metal SAFETY only. HMTc does not endorse, approve, or vouch for the efficacy or legality of these products.
reference_method: ICP-MS per USP General Chapter <233> (or an equivalently validated ICP-MS / ICP-OES elemental method) on the finished product in its as-sold form: total-element quantitation for the eight totals (Pb, Cd, tAs, tHg, Ni, Sn, Al, total Cr), with reflex inorganic-arsenic speciation (HPLC-ICP-MS) on an elevated total-arsenic result and reflex hexavalent-chromium speciation on an elevated total-chromium result.
